title: Publish a stable discovery file for every client
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Write and keep ~/.susi/ports.json (ports, token path, TLS state) fresh so no client hardcodes 9090-9094. Tests zc_ports_file_*.
